FN-QNW3M11-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 58
Committee: Finance and Taxation General Fund Sponsor: Senator Arthur Orr
Analyst: Michael Russo Date: 01/21/2026
Senate Bill 58 as introduced could increase the obligations of the State General Fund,
Education Trust Fund, county and municipal general funds, and agency or board operating funds
by an undetermined amount to the extent that public officials or employees use public funds to
defend themselves in felony investigations related to their public office or position. Any
increase in obligations, could be offset, in whole or in part, by an undetermined amount,
dependent upon the amount of compensation paid back by public officials and employees
convicted of a felony offense in connection with the public officials or employees public
position.

FN-QNW3M11-2
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 58
Committee: Ways and Means General Fund Sponsor: Senator Arthur Orr
Analyst: Michael Russo Date: 02/24/2026
Senate Bill 58 as passed the Senate could increase receipts of various state or local funds by an
undetermined amount dependent the amount of any compensation repaid by public officials and
employees convicted of a felony offense in connection with their public position.
